summary: Approved after adversarial review bound the exact 31-producer inventory to immutable projected workflow, event, job, matrix, and transitive dependency evidence; global context multiplicity is preserved, unsafe PR filters fail closed, and prepared optional evidence is mechanically separated from active bindings.

findings.summary: Red-path tests asserted only active bindings and could miss evidence leaking through prepared or inactive optional channels; the final suite pins all three channels empty.

limitations: This slice does not compare inventory names with the checked-in or live required-check ruleset and does not authorize the optional 31-to-32 transition.

Live active-workflow and integration identity, effective ambient permissions, conditional-step meaning, runtime event provenance, and candidate-independent enforcement remain later API, hardening, and base-controlled activation slices.
